question: Karkidaka Vavu Bali of ______ is a Hindu ritual to appease ancestors.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __Kerala__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In Kerala, thousands of devotees flocked to Kerala's bathing ghats and temples to participate in the "Karkidaka vavu Bali" ceremony. 
 
• The Karkidaka vavu Bali is a ritual followed by the devotees to pay obeisance to the departed ancestors in their families.
 
• The rituals began in the early morning hours with special poojas.
 
• Large number of devotees gathered in Aluva Manappuram, Thirunavaya, Varkala, Thirunelly, Pampa and other prominent balitharpan' sites across the state.
